verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting through November 23 said no official French, Israeli, or U.S. response had been received to Owens's assassination allegation. Later reporting quoted the French Armed Forces Ministry disputing a related factual premise about French Foreign Legion training, but no complete public record was found establishing whether each named institution had specifically disputed the Macrons-paid-for-assassination allegation by the episode's December 8 publication date. The public-silence portion has support, but the categorical four-institution claim cannot be fully confirmed.
